method: Independent static reading of preserved x86-64 module bytes, relocations, disassembly, source diff and metadata. No host build/test, execution of archived code, or VM access.

legacy_admission.two_phase_reads_intentionally_retained: The generic exact-owner predicate accepts HELD/COMBINER; a separate read requires COMBINER.

abi2_admission.two_phase_reads_intentionally_retained: The generic exact-owner predicate accepts HELD/COMBINER; a separate read requires COMBINER.

default-off.expected_node_identity: Source BUG_ON(batch->pin.node != node) is preserved and fixture-mutated. The ELF folds this tautological compare: the exact selected pointer is stored into the descriptor and used unchanged for the final key/generation reads and first borrowed preparation. No separate expected-node compare is claimed at ordinary admission; later cold/completion compares remain emitted.
default-off.cold_generic_path: A generic/failed-minimal frame path closes the epoch, then freshly checks closed private epoch, exact current descriptor/key/generation and strict CLAIMED before borrowed inputs or frame-provider call.
default-off.cold_promotion: epoch_end is byte-and-relocation identical to a46: READY->CLAIMED store precedes private epoch clear and HELD CAS along control flow; retained/empty-aware closure remains intact.
default-off.fresh_completion: The run_combiner instruction sequence is unchanged after address normalization. The execute_cs native completion also retains exact descriptor/key/generation, strict CLAIMED and dual READY/CLAIMED proof before descriptor removal and result-zero publication.
default-off.waiter_contract: Count publication and optional debug branch precede checked INIT->READY store, incoming link, observe-only poll. Valid loop states 0/WAIT/READY/CLAIMED remain; INIT rejects; 65536 PAUSE budget precedes need_resched. Withdrawal keeps real CAS; private first-head INIT->WAIT and role-C source-put->INIT-to-READY->W-ready ordering remain.
default-off.optional_diagnostics: No pin statistics symbols/parameter in mode0; mode2 counters are private inline arithmetic in admission, with no helper/fentry between final proof and first borrowed preparation. Static per-CPU size stays unchanged.

limits: No performance gain or acceptance is inferred from instruction removal or code size.
Static review does not establish live scheduler/concurrency correctness or arbitrary compiler/architecture behavior.
Mode2 performs real diagnostic bookkeeping and is not interchangeable with default-off performance results.
Successful admission load counts exclude the deliberately separate execute-entry proof and later fresh completion/cold-boundary proofs.
Normalized instruction comparison removes printed absolute branch/call addresses and RIP comments; it is not a claim that relocation records or entire functions are byte-identical.
